title: Transfers T3b: renaming rules assign the payee (whole), several rules per payee, and a rule on a transfer payee makes a complete transfer at import and sync
description: Plan .agents/plans/2026-11-24_transfers-refactor.md task T3b. Today a 'contains' renaming rule rewrites only the matching part of the imported text ('PIX SAVINGS 42' -> 'Transfer : X 42', an ordinary payee) and a payee holds one rule. Target: a matching rule sets the transaction's payee to the rule's payee (import text kept as the import name); a payee can hold several rules; when the rule's payee is an account's transfer payee the imported row becomes a complete transfer (mirror or matcher link), on register create, bulk import and bank sync. Additive schema.
notes:
Carry-overs from review-nq2f-4.md (on budget-nq2f): F-a with a bad account pointer /bulk creates an ordinary payee named 'Transfer : <account>' (later repair could make a half transfer); F-b a duplicate row that carries its own import_id still creates its raw-text payee; F-c a leg moved to another account and back then unlinked ends with no payee; F-d a hint naming a soft-deleted account blocks the row from matching any other account. Also unchecked: a renaming rule whose output differs from the text only by surrounding spaces.
